name: PerkDrop
shortDescription: Discover local offers, events, free activities and your next plan
fullDescription:
Find something worth doing with PerkDrop.

Explore local food offers, events, experiences, free activities and family outings across Australia. Choose a suburb or postcode, use optional Near me, and set your search distance from 1 to 200 kilometres.

MAKE A PLAN
Browse clear venue cards, explore your search circle on the map, or use quick choices for free entry, tonight, the weekend and family activities. Dates use checked source information. When your selected area is quiet, choose a wider search to explore more options.

SAVE YOUR FINDS
Save offers and activities for later. Connect your own devices with a private, one-time link to share access to your saves, plans and supported passes. The website planner can add an outing to your calendar.

KNOW THE NEXT STEP
See the listed price, timing, conditions and source before you go. Publicly advertised listings open the venue or organiser's website. Booking-required offers are completed with the provider. Only genuinely supported, available merchant inventory can issue a PerkDrop pass.

BROWSING IS SIMPLE
No subscription or sign-in is required to browse. Location is optional; manual area search works without location permission. Settings includes Delete PerkDrop data. Cached offline catalogue entries are labelled and cannot issue claims.

Offers and events vary by area. Prices, dates and availability can change. Check each listing's current source, booking requirements and conditions before travelling or paying. A listing or source link is not a booking confirmation.
reviewAccessNotes: Browse without a user login, subscription or payment. Guest-device access is created securely for saves. Deny location and choose a suburb/postcode instead. Try Adelaide, open Filters, choose 10 km and Food, and apply the resulting count. Closing the filter sheet discards unapplied edits. Choose Craigmore/5114 at 1 km for quiet-area recovery, then explicitly widen the radius. Open a listing, read conditions, save/unsave and check Saved. Check the map circle, source links and directions. Claims appear only for actual supported inventory; public-source listings do not issue passes. This initial Android profile keeps remote push disabled because Android FCM/device delivery has not been verified. The map and public detail pages use trusted perkdrop.au WebViews. The website planner uses explicit private-device pairing. Settings includes data deletion with typed confirmation. Event facts are sourced; imagery is owned, licensed or authorised with attribution, or an illustrated fallback.
releaseNotes: Find nearby offers sooner, choose distance and interests in one filter sheet, explore the map, and use clearer source, booking and supported-claim actions.
